name: Your Room Addition Project: What to Expect

step.name: Step 1: Initial Design & Scope Definition (1-2 weeks): We'll sit down to un…
step.text: Initial Design & Scope Definition (1-2 weeks): We'll sit down to understand your needs, ideas, and what you're hoping to achieve with the new space. This is where your vision starts to take shape.

step.name: Step 2: Feasibility & Planning (2-4 weeks): We'll assess zoning, site condi…
step.text: Feasibility & Planning (2-4 weeks): We'll assess zoning, site conditions, and how the addition integrates with your home's existing structure and utilities. This step helps iron out any potential challenges early on.

step.name: Step 3: Drawing & Engineering (4-8 weeks): This is where detailed architect…
step.text: Drawing & Engineering (4-8 weeks): This is where detailed architectural, structural, and trade drawings are created. An architect or structural engineer might get involved if your project is complex, especially if load-bearing elements are changing.

step.name: Step 4: Permit Acquisition (4-16 weeks): We submit the plans and manage the…
step.text: Permit Acquisition (4-16 weeks): We submit the plans and manage the permit review process with local building departments. This timeframe can vary quite a bit depending on your specific jurisdiction's workload and any plan-review comments we might need to address.

step.name: Step 5: Construction (Months, varies by scope): Once permits are approved,…
step.text: Construction (Months, varies by scope): Once permits are approved, the real building begins, from foundation to finishes. This phase involves various trades and consistent progress.

step.name: Step 6: Final Inspections & Walkthrough: The last step before you enjoy you…
step.text: Final Inspections & Walkthrough: The last step before you enjoy your new space, ensuring everything is up to code and exactly what you envisioned.
